lines: Holy Victory Highway you're so close to the next badge!
Remember the feeling when your parents made you be home early, don't let this moment feel like that!
She's not gonna see the credit card bill for a month!!
Just get her some flowers that'll make up for just one more!
Go ahead and grab it- Then surprise her with her favorite dessert and all will be right in the world.
You can just about get away with murder by surprising her randomly with dessert/flowers, do you think one more hot sauce won't be covered? Do it.
Shhhh!! Do you hear that? That's the sound of hopes and desires leaving without you. --Don't let it go, bro.
